_about: Round 16 (2026-11-26): real recordings for common sounds (Anthony: 'yes on 6 too'). Current is the round 14 winner (layered effects, pro mix), every sound generated. Earlier rounds are in variants_round*.json and variants_layers.json. Round 17 (2026-11-26): Anthony asked to rebuild the whole thing from real recordings and generate only what the library lacks. Current is now the round 16 winner.

variants.label: Everything from real recordings
variants.why: Every sound, the continuous ones too (vacuum motor, suction air, pattering feet), is looked for in the library first and made one at a time. A sound is generated only when the library has nothing that would sound right.
